name: Lap An Lagoon
kicker: Brackish lagoon between Phu Gia and the bay
summary: Look across the lagoon from the shore or from Nguyễn Văn, at oyster stakes, round boats, and the mountain. A sand strip shows only at a strong low tide. No access fee is set. Skip it if you only wanted the sea swim.
getThere: Nguyễn Văn runs along the lagoon. Minutes from the beach strip are check on arrival.
heroCaption: Boats on Lap An, with the mountain and the viaduct behind them

notice.title: The sand strip is only there at low tide
notice.body: The sand strip shows at a strong low tide and is easy to miss. Do not start across it as the tide turns.

body: Look from the shore, from Phú Gia, or from Nguyễn Văn. This is a brackish lagoon beside Highway 1A at đèo Phú Gia, the Bach Ma range on one side and the bay on the other. Oyster lines and round boats are the working landscape. The 2018 plan makes this lagoon the service and dining subzone of the national tourism area.

At a strong low tide a sand bridge, cây cầu cát, shows across the water. It is short. Turn back before the tide covers it. One account uses Đầm An Cư as another name for this lagoon, at the foot of Phú Gia. The zone office describes Đầm An Cư at the foot of Hai Van as its own water. Do not assume the two names are one shore until you are there.

Oyster farming here dates from the late 1990s. The plates are hàu nướng trui, cháo hàu, hàu xào hành tây, and gỏi hàu, eaten on the lagoon. No stall price is set. A price quoted for one household raft is not a town ticket. March to June is the best-looking stretch in one account, and it is not a harvest calendar. Time on the bank is check on arrival.

figures.caption: The lagoon shore and the mountain behind it
figures.alt: Lap An lagoon with forested mountains behind the far shore

gettingThere: Nguyễn Văn is the lagoon road, on the land side of the beach strip. A walking stretch along it runs about 450 m from the new market toward Trường THCS Lăng Cô. That length is the design of the walking street, not a measured walk from the sand. Minutes from the beach are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Lang Co beach
legs.body: The lagoon is the land side of the same strip. Walk or ride to Nguyễn Văn. Minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hue
legs.body: The town is about 60 km south of Hue center. The lagoon is inside the town, at đèo Phú Gia. Drive minutes are check on arrival.

hours: Check on arrival. No opening clock is set.
closed: No weekly closing day is set. The sand bridge is absent except at a strong low tide.
admissionNote: No lagoon access fee is set. Check on arrival if someone asks. A price quoted for one household raft is not a town ticket.
